source: derived from ERC-8354 reference implementation (zexoverz/confidential-agent-policy-verdicts) via cast
note: Golden conformance vectors for ERC-8354 Confidential Agent Policy Verdicts. Every language port MUST reproduce expected exactly.

vectors.desc: actionCommitment = keccak256(abi.encode(chainId, domainId, agentId, target, value, keccak256(callData), actionNonce)). callData is empty (0x), so callDataHash = keccak256('') = 0xc5d2460186f7233c927e7db2dcc703c0e500b653ca82273b7bfad8045d85a470. GUARDS the empty-callData edge: an impl that special-cases empty callData to bytes32(0) fails this vector.

verdictDigest = EIP-712 hashTypedDataV4 over Verdict with domain name=ConfidentialPolicyVerdict, version=1, chainId, verifyingContract. The Verdict type is Verdict(uint256 agentId,bytes32 domainId,bytes32 policyRoot,bytes32 actionCommitment,address executor,uint64 expiry,bytes32 nullifier,uint8 decision,uint8 policyKind).
